description: Reports that you disagree with a diagnosis shown by the listDiagnoses tool; queued for manager review. Use this after listDiagnoses when you believe a rule violation was incorrectly diagnosed or classified into an issue, providing the engineID and ruleID shown in the diagnosis and your reason. Returns a confirmation with disposition details.

catalogIndex.description: Identifier of the issue-exhibiting element in the catalog of elements on the page (example: 372)

engineID.description: Identifier of the rule engine that produced the disputed diagnosis (example: axe), as shown in the listDiagnoses output

reason.description: 20- to 1000-character explanation of why the diagnosis is disputed

ruleID.description: Identifier of the rule whose diagnosis is disputed, as shown in the listDiagnoses output (example: color-contrast); if that output shows null for the rule identifier, use its description of the violation instead
